title: Divergent HIF isoform association is linked to hypoxia responses in Mesenchymal stromal cells and human dermal fibroblasts
task: Compare hypoxia-responsive transcriptomic programs between MSCs and fibroblasts
key_results: MSCs showed 2-4 fold more differentially expressed genes than HDFs under hypoxia; MSCs predominantly employed HIF1A-centered networks while HDFs relied more on HIF2A/HIF3A signaling
comments: Demonstrates that cell-type identity fundamentally determines hypoxic adaptation strategy despite phenotypic overlap, with important implications for regenerative medicine applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: MSCs and HDFs engage equivalent adaptive programs under hypoxic stress
hypotheses.result: Rejected; MSCs showed broader remodeling with distinct HIF1A dominance versus HDF HIF2A/3A reliance

title: The marine drug plitidepsin alleviates osteoporosis in estrogen-deficient mice by suppressing ROS-mediated NRF2/HO-1 signaling and osteoclast formation
task: Evaluate plitidepsin efficacy in suppressing osteoclast formation and estrogen-deficiency-induced bone loss
key_results: Plitidepsin suppressed osteoclast formation with reduced multinucleated cells and disrupted actin rings; in OVX mice, it alleviated trabecular bone loss and preserved bone microarchitecture
comments: The dual action on both ROS-mediated signaling and osteoclast differentiation suggests plitidepsin could address multiple pathogenic mechanisms in osteoporosis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Plitidepsin suppresses osteoclastogenesis by modulating ROS and NRF2/HO-1 signaling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; plitidepsin attenuated ROS accumulation and enhanced antioxidant defense through NRF2/HO-1 activation

title: Beauvericin exhibits antitumor activity in pancreatic cancer cells: Integrative analysis suggests potential modulation of the KEAP1-NRF2-HMOX1 axis and survival signaling pathways
task: Investigate anticancer mechanisms of Beauvericin in pancreatic cancer cells via KEAP1-NRF2 modulation
key_results: Beauvericin achieved IC₅₀ = 1.45 µM in Mia PaCa-2 cells; suppressed colony formation (0.5 µM), migration (1 µM), and induced 50.06% apoptosis (2 µM); docking predicted KEAP1 binding with energy -9.45 kcal/mol
comments: Computational predictions of KEAP1 interaction are supported by functional data showing NRF2 pathway modulation, though direct KEAP1 binding should be biochemically validated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Beauvericin interacts with KEAP1 to modulate NRF2/HMOX1 signaling
hypotheses.result: Partially supported; docking and MD simulations predicted stable BEA-KEAP1 complex; modulation of KEAP1/NRF2 expression observed but direct binding unconfirmed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Beauvericin suppresses survival signaling through AKT, ERK1/2, and STAT3
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dose-dependent reduction in phosphorylation of all three kinases

title: 3-O-Acetylrubiarbonol B induces apoptosis of colorectal cancer cells by activating JNK/p38 MAPK and ROS generation
task: Determine apoptotic mechanisms of 3-O-Acetylrubiarbonol B in oxaliplatin-resistant colorectal cancer cells
key_results: ARu-B achieved IC₅₀ values of 5.4 µM (HCT116) and 4.0 µM (HCT116-OxR); induced G2/M arrest, ROS generation, and caspase-dependent apoptosis via JNK/p38 MAPK phosphorylation
comments: The compound's enhanced potency in drug-resistant cells (4.0 vs 5.4 µM) is promising, though the mechanism of resistance circumvention remains unclear.

model_io.model: HCT116 and HCT116-OxR colorectal cancer cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: JNK and p38 MAPK phosphorylation are essential for ARu-B-induced apoptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; pretreatment with SP600125 and SB203580 prevented apoptosis

hypotheses.hypothesis: ROS generation mediates ARu-B-induced apoptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; NAC pretreatment blocked cytotoxicity

title: Predicting measles outbreak magnitude via modeled population susceptibility evidence from pre-vaccination data
task: Predict measles outbreak magnitude from population susceptibility
key_results: Reconstructed susceptibility (S0) strongly associated with observed attack rates; model accurately reproduced temporal dynamics across all regions
comments: Mechanistic approach integrating time series and demographics is sound, though reliance on historical pre-vaccination data limits applicability to modern contexts.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reconstructed S0 predicts subsequent year attack rates
hypotheses.result: Strong association demonstrated across England, Wales, and five largest cities

title: Optimizing CRISPR–Cas9-mediated TCR knockout in primary mouse CD8+, CD4+, and regulatory T cells
task: Optimize CRISPR–Cas9 TCR knockout in primary mouse T cells
key_results: >98% knockout in Jurkat cells; 95% (CD8+), 80% (CD4+), 85% (Tregs) in primary mouse T cells; minimal viability loss; validated by ICE analysis
comments: Comprehensive optimization across T cell subsets with robust validation; modest Treg viability reduction warrants further investigation for therapeutic applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimized RNP conditions achieve high TCR knockout efficiency across T cell subsets
hypotheses.result: 95% (CD8+), 80% (CD4+), 85% (Tregs) knockout with minimal viability impact; edited cells retained activation capacity

title: Quokka swarm defensive optimization-based ensemble deep learning for disease prediction using remote monitoring data
task: Disease prediction from physiological monitoring signals
key_results: 96.90% accuracy, 95.87% TPR, 7.22% FPR on MIMIC-II database
comments: High performance claims should be tempered by single-database evaluation and lack of external validation; QSDO optimization contribution not clearly isolated.

model_io.model: QSDO_Ensemble DL (ResNeXt, AHANet, SA-Net with hyperparameter tuning)
inputs: physiological signals (II, III, AVL, AVF, ABP)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ensemble deep learning with QSDO hyperparameter tuning improves disease prediction robustness
hypotheses.result: Achieved 96.90% accuracy with low FPR on MIMIC-II cohort

title: Leakage-aware hybrid tabular deep learning with target-provenance auditing for calorie-expenditure prediction and constrained exercise food recommendation
task: Predict calorie expenditure with leakage-aware auditing and exercise-food recommendation
key_results: MAE 101.68 kcal (1.7% above theoretical floor of 100 kcal); 80% profile coverage, 100% catalogue coverage with no constraint violations
comments: Exceptional rigor in target variable validation and leakage detection; finding that outcome is indistinguishable from noise limits predictability and raises questions about data utility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid tabular deep learning achieves near-optimal calorie prediction after leakage removal
hypotheses.result: MAE 101.68 kcal on 773 test instances, within 1.7% of theoretical lower bound

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic recommender maintains constraint satisfaction and high coverage
hypotheses.result: 80% profile coverage, 100% catalogue coverage, zero constraint violations across 1200 candidates

title: Missing data imputation for wearable time series
task: Impute missing data in wearable physiological time series
key_results: PMSI outperformed five baselines: RMSE 7.53 vs 8.18–10.01 (high-adherence), 8.81 vs 9.02–15.86 (low-adherence); identified daily and 3.5-day periodicities
comments: Well-designed validation on smartwatch data with known missingness patterns; framework is elegant and potentially transferable to other periodic signals.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Modeling multi-scale periodic dependencies improves imputation accuracy
hypotheses.result: PMSI achieved RMSE 7.53 (high-adherence) and 8.81 (low-adherence), significantly better than five conventional methods

title: Prototype-based explainable deep learning for sex classification of Mountain Gazelles in the wild
task: Sex classification of Mountain Gazelles via explainable prototype-based deep learning
key_results: 75% global accuracy and F1-score; prototypes capture horn, body, leg, and head morphological features consistent with literature
comments: Prototype-based approach provides valuable explainability for ecological applications; modest accuracy reflects real challenge of camera-trap data variability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-fixed prototypes capture larger, semantically coherent regions enabling transparent sex classification
hypotheses.result: 75% accuracy with explanations identifying horn, body, leg, and head features; males distinguished via horn morphology

title: Comparative genomics of Actinomyces identifies an MRONJ-associated lineage characterized by variation in mfd
task: Identify MRONJ-associated Actinomyces lineage via comparative genomics
key_results: MRONJ-derived isolates clustered in Actinomyces lineage dominated by A. oris with distinct mfd variant; 3D structure prediction revealed potential differences
comments: Novel use of selective medium and long-read sequencing strengthens isolate characterization; functional significance of mfd variant remains speculative.

model_io.model: Comparative genomic analysis with structure prediction

hypotheses.hypothesis: MRONJ-associated Actinomyces cluster within specific lineage with mfd variation
hypotheses.result: Most MRONJ isolates clustered in A. oris-dominated lineage characterized by distinct mfd variant; structural differences predicted

title: A course recommendation method based on bidirectional fusion of graph convolution using knowledge graphs
task: Course recommendation via bidirectional knowledge graph fusion
key_results: KGCN-RN achieved competitive/superior performance on MOOCCube with HR and NDCG metrics
comments: Framework addresses sparsity and cold-start issues, but evaluation limited to single dataset; generalization unclear.

model_io.model: KGCN-RN (bidirectional fusion of knowledge graph convolution and RippleNet)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint modeling of user preference propagation and course semantic aggregation improves recommendations
hypotheses.result: Bidirectional fusion strategy achieved competitive/superior performance versus baselines

title: Integrated multi-omics analyses reveal the role of PAXX in colorectal cancer progression and the tumor immune microenvironment
task: Identify PAXX role in colorectal cancer progression and tumor immune microenvironment
key_results: PAXX upregulated in CRC, associated with poorer survival; PAXX knockdown suppressed proliferation/migration/EMT via MAPK/ERK signaling; high PAXX linked to distinct immune/stromal characteristics
comments: Comprehensive multi-omics integration with functional validation strengthens findings; immune/intercellular communication predictions remain computationally inferred.

model_io.model: Multi-omics integration pipeline with functional knockdown

hypotheses.hypothesis: PAXX promotes CRC progression via MAPK/ERK signaling and EMT
hypotheses.result: PAXX knockdown reduced p-MEK1/2 and p-ERK1/2; EGF stimulation partially rescued malignant phenotypes

hypotheses.hypothesis: PAXX expression associates with distinct immune microenvironment
hypotheses.result: High PAXX linked to particular immune and stromal characteristics; HGF/VEGF communication predicted

title: Complement C3a receptor expression is associated with distinct immune microenvironmental profiles in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
task: Characterize C3aR expression and immune microenvironment in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
key_results: C3aR predominantly expressed in myeloid compartment (98% CD68+, 68% CD163+); associated with distinct immune profiles inversely correlated with macrophage density
comments: Multi-modal integration (bulk RNA-seq, scRNA-seq, IHC) is thorough; however, C3AR1 not independently prognostic, limiting clinical utility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: C3aR expression marks distinct myeloid-associated immune context in ccRCC
hypotheses.result: C3aR+ density correlated with CD4+ infiltration, inversely with CD68+ macrophages; three immune profiles identified

title: A multi-algorithm generative framework for urban design: integrating road networks, green spaces and building forms
task: Multi-algorithm generative urban design framework integrating road networks, green spaces, and building forms
key_results: End-to-end generation time 3 min 48.23 s for 10 km² scheme; framework generalizes across 20 sites of varying scales and contexts
comments: Encapsulates multiple algorithms into a visual platform but lacks quantitative metrics for design quality or sustainability assessment.

model_io.model: Multi-algorithm urban design framework (road network → green space → building form)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Systematic generative sequence (skeleton→green space→buildings) ensures spatial rationality and coherence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: framework generalizes across 20 diverse sites with sub-4-minute generation time

title: UPF4ROS2 for integrating planner independent task planning into ROS 2
task: Integrating automated planning into ROS 2 robotics systems
key_results: Sub-second planning-service latencies; equivalent mission-level behavior and plan lengths versus PlanSys2 baseline across 20 dynamic missions
comments: Demonstrates that planner-independent abstraction can be achieved without performance compromise, though additional overhead in temporal-numeric benchmarks is noted.

model_io.model: UPF4ROS2 (Unified Planning Framework integrated with ROS 2)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Planner-independent integration maintains equivalent performance to baseline systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: equal plan lengths and mission-level behavior under unit-action-count metric

title: A stability-oriented framework based on adaptive hunger games search for non-convex economic dispatch
task: Non-convex economic dispatch optimization with valve-point effects and operational constraints
key_results: AHGS achieves best Friedman mean rank of 2.18 across TC1–TC17; reduces run-to-run variance 57.06%–99.52% vs. HGS; statistically significant improvements over HGS and PTBO
comments: Demonstrates stability improvements via adaptive mechanisms but wall-clock time advantage is attributed to population reduction rather than per-evaluation efficiency.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive mechanisms (quadratic shrink, unified directional update, hunger-controlled crossover) improve stability of HGS
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 77.49% average variance reduction and statistically significant wins on benchmark cases

title: Detailed identification method of blue and white porcelain decorative patterns for cultural heritage protection
task: Fine-grained recognition of blue-and-white porcelain decorative patterns for heritage preservation
key_results: Improved ConvNeXt_Tiny achieves 97.26% accuracy, 1.63% higher than vanilla baseline; superior feature extraction on porcelain dataset
comments: Domain-specific CNN improvement is substantial but evaluation on a single limited dataset raises generalization concerns.

model_io.model: Improved ConvNeXt_Tiny with RFB multi-scale and Triplet attention modules
inputs: porcelain decoration images (plant, animal, human, geometric)

hypotheses.hypothesis: RFB and Triplet attention modules improve fine-grained recognition of subtle texture and edges
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 97.26% accuracy with 1.63% improvement over vanilla ConvNeXt_Tiny

title: Statistically grounded evaluation of demographic bias in deep facial representations using FairFace and UTKFace
task: Evaluating demographic fairness in pretrained deep facial representations across model architectures and datasets
key_results: ResNet50 highest overall accuracy; MobileNetV3 more consistent subgroup performance; intersectional analysis reveals persistent disparities despite overall accuracy improvements
comments: Unified fairness evaluation framework is methodologically sound but highlights that aggregate metrics mask equity issues.

model_io.model: ResNet50, MobileNetV3, DeiT with ImageNet pretraining
inputs: facial images from FairFace and UTKFace datasets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pretrained facial representations encode demographic information separable via logistic probes, with disparities across demographic groups
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: logistic probe outperformed 1-NN; persistent demographic disparities in intersectional analysis despite high overall accuracy

title: Developing meta-FM machine learning model with application for personalized language learning environment
task: Personalized learning path generation via meta-pretrained factorization machines with cold-start handling
key_results: Significant improvements in personalization accuracy and adaptation speed; efficient memory usage with mixed-precision quantization; robust cold-start performance on multilingual student logs
comments: Addresses cold-start through meta-learning but lacks specific quantitative benchmarks (e.g., exact accuracy gains) in the abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Meta-learning with cross-modal feature augmentation enables rapid cold-start adaptation for new learners
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: significant improvements in adaptation speed and personalization accuracy

title: Enhancing bending load prediction of CaCO₃-filled polypropylene composites via data augmentation and ensemble machine learning
task: Predicting bending load of CaCO₃-filled PP composites under small-sample conditions via data augmentation
key_results: XGBoost trained on 249-sample augmented dataset achieves R² = 0.8061 with lowest MSE; particle size distribution identified as most influential factor
comments: Cubic spline interpolation effectively expands limited experimental data but results are specific to this composite system and may not generalize.

model_io.model: Ensemble (SVM, RF, XGBoost) with cubic spline interpolation augmentation
inputs: CaCO₃ filler parameters from orthogonal design

hypotheses.hypothesis: Data augmentation via cubic spline interpolation significantly improves predictive performance under small-sample conditions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: XGBoost achieves best R² = 0.8061 on expanded 249-sample dataset

title: Thermal analysis and CFD-assisted machine learning prediction of temperature fields in direct-contact membrane distillation using darts game optimization
task: Predicting spatial temperature distribution in membrane distillation via hyperparameter-tuned regression
key_results: DGO-GPR achieves R² = 0.99907 (test), DGO-MLP achieves R² = 0.99502 (test) with MAPE 6.81e−04; DGO-WLS achieves R² = 0.88636 with higher MAE
comments: Demonstrates effective hyperparameter optimization via dart game algorithm but results are specific to the CFD configuration studied.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dart game optimization improves hyperparameter tuning across different regression architectures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: DGO-GPR and DGO-MLP achieve excellent test R² and low error metrics

title: Time-scaled quantum simulation of dissipative nanoelectronics with zero gate overhead
task: Simulating dissipative nanoelectronics on NISQ devices without active dissipative gates
key_results: Zero active gate overhead for amplitude-damping Lindblad dynamics; lower RMSE than stochastic-reset comparators in 2-qubit benchmark
comments: Hardware-intrinsic time-scaling exploits T₁ relaxation elegantly, but scalability to many-qubit systems and material-motivated regimes remains limited by NISQ coherence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Native delay instructions map T₁ onto Lindblad dissipation without additional gates
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on IBM quantum architectures for magnon and phonon transport regimes

title: A compact 2D photonic crystal biosensor for optical detection of glioblastoma brain tissues enhanced by neural networks
task: Compact photonic crystal biosensor for glioblastoma tissue classification via neural networks
key_results: Quality factor 4777, sensitivity 933 nm/RIU, detection limit 4.2×10⁻⁵, thermal stability 25–40°C, ANN-enhanced classification accuracy
comments: Neural network classification is pragmatic for clinical deployment, but the abstract lacks quantitative accuracy metrics and validation statistics essential for medical device assessment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-Q photonic resonator with ANN post-processing enables discrimination of glioblastoma from peritumorous tissue
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: computational proof-of-concept demonstrates superior accuracy and footprint versus recent optical sensors

title: ThermoPix: an electronic-photonic temperature sensor array with microsecond row readout
task: High-spatial-resolution temperature sensing via electronic-photonic integrated array
key_results: Temperature sensitivity 3.12 ns/K, row readout time 2 µs, post-calibration MAE 0.49 K, 150 nW optical power per cell
comments: Valley photonic crystal interferometer architecture is elegant, but 1.07 K nominal resolution suggests practical limitations for sub-kelvin applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phase-transition-material threshold detection enables timing-based temperature readout compatible with CMOS
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: circuit simulations and Monte Carlo analysis validate 0.49 K MAE performance

title: Spin–orbit–controlled flat-band transition, thermodynamic and magnetic response in a disordered Lieb-5 lattice
task: Engineering flat-band spectrum via spin-orbit coupling and disorder in Lieb-5 lattice
key_results: ISOC transforms two flat bands into a single FB at zero energy; disorder creates tunable heat capacity peaks and disorder-dependent paramagnetic susceptibility
comments: Tight-binding Green's function approach with SCBA provides practical control mechanism, though experimental realization on Lieb-5 remains challenging.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ISOC reconstructs FB spectrum while disorder broadens low-energy states
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: progressive weakening of FB features and spectral redistribution observed
